description: Checks whether a string is a well-formed address for EVM (EIP-55 checksum), Solana, Aptos (AIP-40) or Bitcoin (base58check, bech32, bech32m). With family "auto" it lists every family the string could be, and never picks one. A valid format is not evidence an address is safe, owned, or the one you meant.
name: address_format_check
title: Cross-chain address format check
